locales.description: BCP-47 locale tags to ship, e.g. ["en", "fr", "ar"], on the first run, which writes them into the design system's src/config/i18n.ts. The first is the source locale unless --default-locale says otherwise. Defaults to ["en"]. Later runs read the config: change the locales there, then run without this.

defaultLocale.description: The source locale: what untranslated keys fall back to. Defaults to the first entry of locales.

runtimeSpec.description: What to install @angular-capacitor-workspace/i18n from instead of the range this release depends on, such as a file: path to a local build. Used by the integration matrix before a release is published.

apps.description: Applications to wire. Defaults to every application; a prerendered site is built once per locale rather than switched at runtime.
